board_lot_redistribution.assessment: General HKEX terms permit limited personal use and restrict redistribution, derivative compilations and programmatic access without written permission. Existing provenance does not establish a redistribution licence.
board_lot_redistribution.safe_local_work: Keep existing locally supplied table; do not newly scrape the workbook or claim distribution rights. Support user-provided tables and synthetic test fixtures; identify existing upstream CSV as a rights-review item.
